creator: admin
title: Host your own
text:
You need a Cloudflare account on the free plan and a GitHub account. A public site like this one also needs a domain added to Cloudflare.

# Fork [[the repository|https://github.com/DesignThinkerer/tiddlywiki-cloudflare]].
# Follow the [[setup guide|https://github.com/DesignThinkerer/tiddlywiki-cloudflare/blob/main/docs/setup.md]]: a bucket, a queue, the worker, a login, and for a public site a few rules on your domain. About five minutes for a private wiki, ten for a public one.
# Open your admin site. The wiki starts by itself, empty, or import an existing one by dragging its file in.

Nothing in your fork needs editing: your settings live in Cloudflare's dashboard, so an update is GitHub's ''Sync fork''.

How big a wiki the free plan holds, measured, is in the project's [[limits|https://github.com/DesignThinkerer/tiddlywiki-cloudflare/blob/main/docs/limits.md]].
